test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Refrigeration & Air Conditioning Mechanic) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: The interest of (10r)² in r time at rate (r)/(10)% is __________.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal = (10r)²

Time = r

Rate = r/10 %

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest = (Principal × Rate × Time) / 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Simple Interest = ((10r)² × (r/10) × r) / 100

⇒ Simple Interest = (10r × 10r × r × r) / (10 × 100)

⇒ Simple Interest = r⁴ / 10

**∴ The correct answer is (r⁴)/(10).**
